create_msa_features: create MSA features by one-hot encoding rows and computing deletion matrix statistics from an MSA object
create_target_features: create target features from a batch including token one-hot encoding, MSA profile, and reference structure data
create_relative_encoding: create relative position encodings with one-hot embeddings for residue distance, token offset, entity ID, and chain ID
shuffle_msa_rows: shuffle MSA rows randomly using Gumbel-argsort sampling and return the reordered MSA with an updated RNG key
gumbel_argsort_sample: sample indices from logits using the Gumbel-max trick with padding-consistent random number generation
